description: Certificate expiration and exporter health for x509-certificate-exporter v4: Kubernetes Secrets, ConfigMaps and certificate files on nodes.

panels.title: Bundles
panels.description: Secrets, files and other bundles currently held by all sources (x509_source_bundles).

panels.title: Sources Up
panels.description: Sources currently reporting x509_source_up == 1.

panels.title: Sources Down
panels.description: Sources reporting x509_source_up == 0.

panels.title: Errors (last 15m)
panels.description: Source errors in the last 15 minutes, all reasons (x509_source_errors_total).

panels.title: Cert Collisions
panels.description: x509_cert_collision_total, summed over sources.

panels.title: Panics
panels.description: Recovered goroutine panics (x509_panic_total). Expected to stay at 0.

Because of a missing feature in Grafana, critical and warning thresholds from dashboard variables will not affect coloration of the Time Left column in this table.

Thresholds are to be set manually in the Overrides settings for this widget.

Please vote or contribute to issue : https://github.com/grafana/grafana/issues/922
panels.title: Kubernetes Secrets (time left < $list_threshold days)

panels.title: Host Files (time left < $list_threshold days)
Sources Reporting
panels.description: Number of sources exposing x509_source_up, and how many of them report 1.

panels.title: Bundles per Source
panels.description: Bundles currently held by each source (x509_source_bundles). Use it to size the exporter.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Total error rate, plus one series per reason while that reason is non-zero.

panels.title: Cumulative Errors
panels.description: Counter totals since the exporter pod started.

panels.title: Scrape Duration
panels.description: Time to serve a /metrics request (x509_scrape_duration_seconds).

panels.title: Kubernetes Watch Health
panels.description: API watch resyncs (x509_kube_watch_resyncs_total) and transport errors (x509_kube_transport_errors_total). A sustained increase points at network or apiserver trouble.

panels.title: Collisions and Panics
panels.description: x509_cert_collision_total, x509_cert_collision_dropped_total and x509_panic_total. Panics should stay at 0.

panels.title: Kubernetes API Request Latency p95
panels.description: client-go API call latency (x509_kube_request_duration_seconds). Needs exposeDiagnosticMetrics: true.

panels.title: Parse Duration p95
panels.description: Per-format (PEM, PKCS#12) parse latency (x509_parse_duration_seconds). Needs exposeDiagnosticMetrics: true.

panels.title: Informer Queue Depth
panels.description: Event-queue depth (x509_informer_queue_depth). Needs exposeDiagnosticMetrics: true.

panels.title: PKCS#12 Passphrase Failures
panels.description: x509_pkcs12_passphrase_failures_total. Only exposed when a source declares format: pkcs12.
x509_kube_informer_scope: whether a source is namespace-scoped or cluster-scoped. Needs exposeDiagnosticMetrics: true.
